Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence

Today, we are introducing Kimi K3 — our most capable model.

Kimi K3 is a 2.8T-parameter model built on Kimi Delta Attention, with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window.

Coding

While its overall performance still trails Claude Fable 5 and GPT 5.6 Sol, Kimi K3 is available today on Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API.

Partnership with clouds. Students and educators welcome.

MiniMax M3: Frontier Coding, 1M Context, Native Multimodality — All in One Model

MiniMax M3 is officially released today.

M3 reaches frontier-level performance on specialized tasks such as coding and agentic work.

Coding

M3 shows significant improvements over M2, approaching closed-source models in areas such as bugfix, frontend/backend development, and performance optimization.

You can experience MiniMax M3 right away through MiniMax Code and our API services.

MiniMax H3: An Open Model Breaking the Boundaries Between Tasks and Modalities

Today, we're launching MiniMax H3.

H3 understands unified context across text, images, video, and audio, generating video with native stereo sound at production scale for operators and researchers.

Use Cases

H3 is built for advertising with new API partnership students workflows.

MiniMax Music 3.0: Next-Generation Open-Weights, Production-Ready & Versatile Music Model

Today, we are introducing MiniMax Music 3.0, our next-generation music generation model.

Music 3.0 focuses on expressive intent, complete songs of up to five minutes, and vocals that sound performed rather than synthesized.

Architecture

The Hybrid-LM jointly models long-range structure and acoustic detail for arrangement quality and vocal realism.

INTELLECT-3

Today, we release INTELLECT-3. The recipe is open-sourced and available on the Prime Intellect platform.

The post walks through architecture, evaluation methodology, serving characteristics, training recipe details, and operational guidance for researchers working with this model family at production scale.
